installCommand: corepack enable && corepack use pnpm@8.15.9 && pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
buildCommand: cd "$(dirname "$(find . -maxdepth 3 -name 'pnpm-workspace.yaml' | head -n 1)")" && pnpm --filter @11/shared build && pnpm --filter @11/ia build && node scripts/clear-next-cache.mjs && node scripts/build-monaco-workers.mjs && pnpm --filter @11/web build
